fusions.name: Paralysing Mark
fusions.desc: A paralysing sting that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Kill
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health: a thrown sting that deals 24 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Long Sight
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies below half health.
